description.en: At SmartGrid surveying and Engineering, we specialize in advanced Land Surveying techniques and Civil Works in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Africa, ensuring precision, efficiency, and reliability in every project. Our expertise in GIS mapping, drone surveying, and power grid analysis helps optimize infrastructure planning, while our civil engineering services lay the foundation for sustainable development.

Utaalamu wetu katika ramani za GIS, upimaji wa ndege zisizo na rubani, na uchambuzi wa gridi ya nishati husaidia kuboresha mipango ya miundombinu, huku huduma zetu za uhandisi wa miundombinu zikiweka msingi wa maendeleo endelevu.

description.en: We deploy advanced drones to capture high-resolution aerial RGB / LiDAR imagery and multispectral data for Accurate Mapping, Monitoring, Planning, surveying, and engineering.

description.en: The DJI Matrice 300 RTK is a versatile and powerful drone designed for industrial applications, including surveying, mapping, and inspection. It features advanced flight capabilities, long battery life, and the ability to carry various payloads, making it ideal for professional use in challenging environments.
description.sw: DJI Matrice 300 RTK ni ndege isiyo na rubani yenye matumizi mengi na nguvu iliyoundwa kwa ajili ya matumizi ya viwandani, ikijumuisha upimaji, ramani, na ukaguzi. Ina uwezo wa juu wa kuruka, maisha marefu ya betri, na uwezo wa kubeba mizigo mbalimbali, na kuifanya kuwa bora kwa matumizi ya kitaalamu katika mazingira magumu.

description.en: The DJI Air 3S is a compact and portable drone that offers high-quality aerial photography and videography capabilities. It features a dual-camera system, long flight time, and intelligent flight modes, making it suitable for both professional and recreational use.
description.sw: DJI Air 3S ni ndege ndogo na rahisi kubeba inayotoa uwezo wa juu wa upigaji picha na video za angani. Ina mfumo wa kamera mbili, muda mrefu wa kuruka, na njia za kuruka za akili, na kuifanya kuwa inafaa kwa matumizi ya kitaalamu na burudani.

description.en: The DJI Mavic 3M / 3E is a lightweight and portable drone that provides excellent aerial imaging capabilities. It features a high-resolution camera, obstacle avoidance sensors, and intelligent flight modes, making it ideal for capturing stunning photos and videos from the sky.
description.sw: DJI Mavic 3M / 3E ni ndege nyepesi na rahisi kubeba inayotoa uwezo bora wa upigaji picha za angani. Ina kamera ya ubora wa juu, vitambuzi vya kuepuka vizuizi, na njia za kuruka za akili, na kuifanya kuwa bora kwa kupiga picha na video za kuvutia kutoka angani.

description.en: The DJI Mavic 3 Pro is a versatile choice for site documentation and reconnaissance mapping, pairing a triple-camera Hasselblad system with orthomosaic-capable photogrammetry for high-detail visual capture.
description.sw: DJI Mavic 3 Pro ni chaguo hodari kwa ajili ya kuandika hati za tovuti na ramani za uchunguzi, ikichanganya mfumo wa kamera tatu wa Hasselblad na fotogrammetria yenye uwezo wa orthomosaic kwa ajili ya upigaji picha wa kina na wa ubora wa juu.

description.en: The DJI Phantom 4 remains a proven, reliable choice for cadastral and engineering mapping, pairing a mechanical shutter camera with dependable GNSS and vision-based positioning for accurate mapping.
description.sw: DJI Phantom 4 bado ni chaguo lililothibitishwa na la kuaminika kwa ajili ya ramani za cadastral na uhandisi, ikichanganya kamera ya shutter ya mitambo na GNSS ya kuaminika na uwekaji wa msingi wa maono kwa ajili ya ramani sahihi.

headline.en: Not sure where to start? Talk to a surveyor.
headline.sw: Huji wapi unapoanza? Ongea na mpimaji.

description.en: Tell us about your site and your goal — we'll recommend the right survey, the right instruments, and a realistic budget. No obligation, no jargon.
description.sw: Tuambie kuhusu tovuti yako na lengo lako — tutakupendekeza upimaji sahihi, vifaa sahihi, na bajeti ya uwazi. Bila wajibu, bila maneno magumu.

description.en: We provide a wide range of land surveying services, including topographical surveys, boundary surveys, sectional properties, building site surveys, resource mapping, bathymetric surveys, hydrographic surveys, and GIS mapping. Our deliverables include boundary survey reports and plans, cadastral plans for title processing, beacons monumentation, registry maps, 3D spatial data (X, Y, Z), topographical maps, contours, CAD shapefiles, survey reports, PDF map outputs, and other specialized deliverables.
description.sw: Tunatoa huduma mbalimbali za upimaji wa ardhi, ikiwa ni pamoja na upimaji wa topografia, upimaji wa mipaka, mali za sehemu, upimaji wa tovuti za ujenzi, ramani ya rasilimali, upimaji wa bathymetric, upimaji wa hydrographic, na ramani ya GIS. Matokeo yetu yanajumuisha ripoti na mipango ya upimaji wa mipaka, mipango ya cadastral kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa hati miliki, uwekaji wa alama za mipaka, ramani za rejesta, data ya 3D ya anga (X, Y, Z), ramani za topografia, kontua, shapefiles za CAD, ripoti za upimaji, matokeo ya ramani za PDF, na matokeo mengine maalumu.

description.en: Straight answers from the field — the things clients ask us before commissioning their first survey.

question.en: Do I need a survey before construction?
question.sw: Je, nahitaji upimaji kabla ya ujenzi?

answer.en: Yes — and it's the cheapest insurance you'll ever buy. A topographical survey feeds your architectural designs, engineering plans, and county approvals, and it surfaces site realities (slopes, utilities, boundary positions) before they become costly change orders. Building on assumptions is the most expensive mistake in construction.
answer.sw: Ndiyo — na ni bima nafuu zaidi utakayonunua. Upimaji wa topografia unaendesha michoro ya usanifu, mipango ya uhandisi, na idhini za kaunti, na unafichua hali halisi za tovuti (mtelemko, huduma za chini ya ardhi, nafasi ya mipaka) kabla hazijawa mabadiliko ya gharama kubwa. Kujenga kwa dhana ni kosa la ghali zaidi ujenzeni.

question.en: How long does a survey take?

answer.en: Most projects take 1–3 days of fieldwork and 2–7 days of processing and drafting, depending on the size of the site, the terrain, and the deliverables you need. We confirm a clear timeline with your quotation — and flag any delays early, not at handover.
answer.sw: Miradi mingi huchukua siku 1–3 za kazi uwanjani na siku 2–7 za kuchakata na kuchora, kulingana na ukubwa wa tovuti, mazingira, na matokeo unayohitaji. Tunathibitisha ratiba wazi na nukuu yako — na tunaonya ucheleweshaji mapema, si wakati wa kusaini.

question.sw: Mnaweza kugundua huduma za chini ya ardhi?

answer.en: Yes. We use Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) — including the LMX200 — alongside utility mapping techniques to locate buried water lines, power cables, and other infrastructure before you excavate. It protects your crew, your budget, and your programme.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Tunatumia Rada ya Kupenya Ardhi (GPR) — ikiwemo LMX200 — pamoja na mbinu za ramani za huduma kutambua miundombinu yaliyozikwa kama mabomba ya maji na nyaya za umeme kabla ya kuchimba. Inalinda timu yako, bajeti yako, na ratiba yako.

question.en: How much will my survey cost?

answer.en: Boundary surveys start from KES 30,000+, topographical surveys from KES 50,000+, and drone mapping from KES 25,000+. Because every site is different, we price on size, terrain, and accessibility — request a custom quotation and we'll turn it around quickly.
answer.sw: Upimaji wa mipaka huanza KES 30,000+, topografia KES 50,000+, na ramani kwa droni KES 25,000+. Kwa kuwa kila tovuti ni tofauti, tunabei kwa ukubwa, mazingira, na ufikivu — omba nukuu maalum nasi tuitolee haraka.

answer.en: We're based in Nairobi (Ruiru) and work across Kiambu, Machakos, Kajiado, Mombasa, Kisumu, and Nakuru — with full crews regularly deploying to Uganda, Tanzania, Somalia, and the wider East Africa region.
answer.sw: Makao yetu ni Nairobi (Ruiru) na tunafanya kazi Kiambu, Machakos, Kajiado, Mombasa, Kisumu, na Nakuru — na timu kamili inapelekwa mara kwa mara Uganda, Tanzania, Somalia, na mkoa mzima wa Afrika Mashariki.

answer.en: Professional, ready-to-use outputs: topographical maps and contours, boundary and cadastral plans, 3D point clouds, DEM/DSM models, CAD shapefiles, orthomosaics, volumetric reports, and signed survey reports — formatted for engineers, architects, and approval authorities.
answer.sw: Matokeo ya kitaalamu yaliyo tayari kutumika: ramani za topografia na kontua, mipango ya mipaka na cadastral, mawingu ya pointi za 3D, mifano ya DEM/DSM, shapefiles za CAD, orthomosaic, ripoti za kiasi, na ripoti za upimaji zilizosainiwa — zilizopangwa kwa wahandisi, waakitekti, na wamiliki wa idhini.
